boundedConclusion: No additional independently unblocked runtime defect was established by this39-row census. Conditional implementation gaps above remain open; this is not a blanket claim that code or launch work is complete. Source documentation reconciliation and scoped operational/design preparation can proceed, while implementing unknown provider authority or an unapproved moderation policy cannot.

importantReconciliation.finding: The1Oct hourly Facebook context scheduler procedure is superseded by the16Oct approved demand-only retirement. Request-time expiry/account deletion/manual retention remain; untouched expired records have no automatic physical-deletion guarantee. Reconcile the launch procedure and accept an operational cadence rather than blindly restoring deleted schedulers.
